title: getproducts_should_return_active_products_with_optional_filters
description: Test GET /api/trpc/store.getProducts endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with a list of active products when called with valid optional filters.

title: getproductbyslug_should_return_product_details_for_valid_slug
description: Test GET /api/trpc/store.getProductBySlug endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with product details when called with a valid product slug.

title: createorder_should_place_order_with_valid_customer_and_shipping_info
description: Test POST /api/trpc/store.createOrder endpoint to verify it successfully places an order and returns a 200 response with order confirmation when provided valid customer information, shipping address, and items.

title: validatecoupon_should_return_coupon_validation_result_for_valid_code
description: Test POST /api/trpc/store.validateCoupon endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with coupon validation result when provided a valid coupon code.

title: listaddresses_should_require_authentication_and_return_saved_addresses
description: Test GET /api/trpc/store.listAddresses endpoint to verify it returns 401 unauthorized when called without authentication and returns 200 with saved addresses when called with valid authentication token.

title: localadminlogin_should_authenticate_admin_with_valid_credentials
description: Test POST /api/trpc/auth.localAdminLogin endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with authentication token or session data when provided valid admin credentials.

title: listorders_should_return_orders_for_authenticated_admin
description: Test GET /api/trpc/admin.listOrders endpoint to verify it returns a 200 response with an array of orders when called with valid admin authentication and returns 401 unauthorized without authentication.

title: updateorderstatus_should_update_order_status_with_valid_data
description: Test POST /api/trpc/admin.updateOrderStatus endpoint to verify it updates the status of a specific order and returns a 200 response with updated order details when provided valid order identifier and status.

title: createproduct_should_create_new_product_with_valid_data
description: Test POST /api/trpc/admin.createProduct endpoint to verify it creates a new product listing and returns a 200 response with created product details when provided valid product data.

title: deleteorder_should_return_error_for_nonexistent_order_id
description: Test POST /api/trpc/admin.deleteOrder endpoint to verify it returns a 4xx not-found or error response when attempting to delete an order with a non-existent order id.
